messages:
Lina D: dropped a new take on the alerting thresholds list — moved unit selector to the far right to reduce visual clutter. Figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder
Lina D: also prototyped a tiny inline fallback hint: 'next: email' beneath channels when a primary channel is muted
Owen R: skimmed it. unit on the right helps with scanning rows quickly. question: does that break mobile wrapping?
Sam T: mobile wraps ok in the prototype but the unit becomes a separate line at 320px. maybe we should hide unit on very small widths and surface it in the details panel
Aria (a11y): contrast problem with the fallback hint — light gray on white won't meet AA. suggest darker token or a subtle pill background
Lina D: good call. also thinking about how the keyboard sequence flows when expanding the fallback hint. currently expansion is not focusable which is bad
Owen R: make the chevron a real button and the expanded content a region with role=region and aria-label='Fallback channels' so screen readers can jump to it
Aria (a11y): yep. also for the mute/snooze wording: 'Snooze for 30m' reads friendly but might be informal. 'Pause notifications for 30 minutes' is explicit and localizes better
Sam T: localization concern noted. 'Pause' maps cleanly across languages. 'Snooze' might not in some locales
Lina D: we had three copy candidates: 'Mute', 'Snooze', 'Pause'. Lean toward 'Pause' now. will include tooltip: 'Pause notifications — incident remains active'
Owen R: small UX nit: when you pause a channel, the row should show a subtle icon and the ability to undo inline (x) without opening preview
Sam T: +1. quick undo reduces accidental long pauses
Aria (a11y): add live region update for the undo action: role=alert with text 'Notifications resumed for Slack' or similar. Also ensure operation is reachable by Enter/Space on keyboard
Lina D: thinking about the compact density: should we keep 8px vertical padding or drop to 6px? dev says 6px saves a lot of vertical space but risks touch targets on mobile
Owen R: keep 8px for touch. we can reduce to 6px on desktop only via media query
Sam T: action items: 1) update Figma with unit-on-right + hidden-mobile behavior 2) darken fallback hint color and convert to pill in collapsed state 3) make chevron a11y-button and add region/aria-label 4) switch copy to 'Pause' and add tooltip 5) add undo affordance and aria alert for resume 6) confirm mobile touch target sizing
designbot: preview build created for feat/alert-compact-reflow — staging: https://staging.internal/alerts/preview/5678
Owen R: I'll test keyboard flow and mobile touch targets tomorrow
Sam T: I'll push the copy variants to the content tracker and ping localization for a quick screen
Lina D: thanks team. tagging @design-reviews for any final copy/contrast decisions.
